title: LIS Word-Level Transcription
description: S05 Project 1 — Word-level transcription with timestamps for WER ground truth
label_config:
<View>
  <Header value="Word-Level Transcription" />
  <Header value="Listen to the audio and transcribe each utterance exactly as spoken." />
  <Audio name="audio" value="$audio" />
  <Header value="Reference (ASR output — correct any errors)" />
  <Text name="asr_text" value="$asr_text" />
  <TextArea name="transcription" toName="audio" rows="3" placeholder="Enter corrected transcription here..." />
  <Header value="Audio Quality" />
  <Choices name="quality" toName="audio" choice="single">
    <Choice value="clean" />
    <Choice value="noisy" />
    <Choice value="poor" />
  </Choices>
  <Header value="Utterance Boundaries" />
  <RectangleLabels name="utterance_boundaries" toName="audio">
    <Label value="utterance_start" />
  </RectangleLabels>
</View>
